actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: FrankaReachFixed-v0 is registered with entry point robohive.envs.arms.reach_base_v0:ReachBaseV0 and max_episode_steps=50
ReachBaseV0 declares the observation keys qp_robot, qv_robot and reach_err
The observation is the full qpos and qvel as qp_robot and qv_robot plus reach_err, the target site position minus the robot site position
The dense reward weights are reach -1.0, bonus 4.0 and penalty -50
The reach task uses far_th 1.0 and counts a bonus below 0.1 and 0.05: solved is reach_dist < 0.050 and done is reach_dist > 1.0
The environment normalizes actions by default (normalize_act=True) and builds the action space as gym.spaces.Box(-1, 1) of sim.model.nu elements
The observation space is a gym.spaces.Box of -10 to 10 for every element of the observation vector
MujocoEnv.step clips the action to the action space before it is sent to the robot
Under gymnasium, the step result is the five-tuple (obs, reward, terminal, False, info)
The registration comment gives 50 steps of 40 skips at 2 ms, i.e. a 0.08 s environment step and a 4 s episode
dt is the model timestep multiplied by frame_skip
The observation vector is built by concatenating the declared observation keys, so its width is the sum of the key lengths
A reset samples the target site position uniformly from target_xyz_range with the environment random generator

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the random generator of the next reset; the physics of the upstream MuJoCo model is deterministic for one seed and action sequence. The package's fake uses Python's random.Random and a kinematic joint update, while upstream draws from numpy's generator and steps MuJoCo, so one seed does not give the same trajectory on both

gaps: the upstream model is a MuJoCo rigid-body scene of a Franka Panda arm, a table and a target site; the fake backend is a kinematic stand-in (F0-style) that moves joint positions by a fixed gain per action and does not integrate rigid-body dynamics, contacts or actuator forces

the upstream environment, MuJoCo and the scene assets were never run here (the gate installs neither robohive nor mujoco, and package code never imports the clone), so no trajectory of this package was compared with upstream and no physical device was attached
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair
the 50-step episode limit belongs to the TimeLimit wrapper that gymnasium.make adds around the registered environment; the fake applies the same limit directly
the observation is a state vector of joint positions, joint velocities and the reach error; images, contacts and sensor noise are not part of this contract

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
